cues.zh: 解说员：这里是古鲁德瓦拉·班格拉·萨希布神庙
cues.en: Narrator: This is the Gurudwara Bangla Sahib temple
in New Delhi, India.
Open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year,
the temple's kitchen, or langar,
feeds 35,000 to 40,000 people
every day for free.
And on religious holidays,

cues.zh: 这个数字可以激增到远超10万人。
cues.en: that number can swell to well over 100,000 people.
At the heart of this entire operation
is kitchen manager Harbhej Singh,
who makes sure there is always enough to eat.
Narrator: To keep up with demand,
the kitchen uses specialized machines

cues.zh: 这些机器能完成各种工作，
cues.en: that can do everything
from chopping vegetables and stirring stews
to steaming the perfect dal.
We visited the temple

cues.zh: 正值一个叫Gurupurab的特殊节日，
cues.en: during a special holiday called Gurupurab

cues.zh: 来看看它是如何大批量制作节日餐食的。
cues.en: to see how it makes a festive meal in such big batches.
The day begins with making a type of
sweet rice pudding called kheer,

cues.zh: 这是Gurupurab特供的菜单新增品。
cues.en: which is a special menu addition for Gurupurab.

cues.zh: 主厨巴尔比尔·辛格负责整个运作，
cues.en: At the helm of the operation is head chef Balbir Singh,

cues.zh: 他多年来一直监管这一流程。
cues.en: who's been overseeing this process for years.
Narrator: Large bags of white rice

cues.zh: 被倒入金属盆中，手工清洗。
cues.en: are poured into metal bowls and washed by hand.
25 kilograms of the washed rice

cues.zh: 随后被舀入一大锅水中，
cues.en: is then scooped into a massive pot of water
and mixed by a mechanical arm.
Narrator: Once the pot has been filled with milk
and it starts to boil,

cues.zh: 他们倒入一大袋小麦粉。
cues.en: they pour in a large bag of wheat flour.

cues.zh: 旁白：疫情期间，厨房发现
cues.en: Narrator: During the pandemic, the kitchen found itself

cues.zh: 需要用更少的人手做更多的食物。
cues.en: needing to make more food with less staff.
The solution was to introduce pots
that could automatically stir and cook

cues.zh: 大多数菜肴的烹饪时间减半。
cues.en: most dishes in half the time.
Narrator: While the kitchen has embraced
technology for cooking,

cues.zh: 但厨房使用的许多蔬菜
cues.en: many of the vegetables the kitchen uses
are still processed by hand.

cues.zh: 社区厨房最受欢迎的菜品之一
cues.en: One of the most popular dishes the community kitchen makes

cues.zh: 是 aloo matar，一道用土豆、
cues.en: is aloo matar, a curry dish made with potatoes,

cues.zh: 豌豆和奶油番茄酱做成的咖喱菜。
cues.en: peas, and a creamy tomato sauce.

cues.zh: 做这道菜，先要在锅里加热植物油，
cues.en: Making this dish begins with heating vegetable oil
in a pot as a base for the tadka.

cues.zh: 旁白：接着加入成筐的土豆、
cues.en: Narrator: This is followed by baskets of potatoes,
peas,
and large ladles of tomato puree.
Narrator: When the dish is ready,

cues.zh: 厨师们倾斜锅子，把菜全部刮出来。
cues.en: chefs tip the pot and scrape everything out.

cues.zh: 厨房为节日盛宴供应的
cues.en: Another curry dish the kitchen serves

cues.zh: 另一道咖喱菜是 kadhi chawal，
cues.en: for the holiday feast is kadhi chawal,
which is made with a base of cumin, masala,
and dried fenugreek leaves.
When the base is mixed,

cues.zh: 厨师们加入鹰嘴豆粉和悬挂沥干的凝乳。
cues.en: chefs add gram flour and hung curd.

cues.zh: 旁白：在 kadhi 炖煮的同时，
cues.en: Narrator: While the kadhi mixes,

cues.zh: 厨师们在旁边准备这道菜的最后一部分。
cues.en: chefs prepare the final part of the dish on the side.

cues.zh: 他们把菠菜、洋葱、鹰嘴豆粉和香料
cues.en: They mix spinach, onions, gram flour, and spices

cues.zh: 放进大锅里混合，做成 pakodas，也就是炸丸子。
cues.en: in a large pot to make pakodas, or fritters.

cues.zh: 等它们达到合适的浓稠度，
cues.en: When they achieve the right consistency,

cues.zh: 就把面糊倒进锅里快速油炸。
cues.en: the mix is then tossed into a wok and fried quickly.

cues.zh: 然后把这些炸饼加进咖喱里。
cues.en: These fritters are then added into the curry.

cues.zh: 旁白：接下来，厨房要做的是 aloo gobi，
cues.en: Narrator: Next up, the kitchen is making aloo gobi,

cues.zh: 一道用土豆和花椰菜做的简单素食。
cues.en: a simple vegetarian dish made with potatoes and cauliflower.
It starts with a tadka base of cumin,
turmeric, and chili powder.

cues.zh: 然后厨师们加入一筐筐花椰菜和土豆。
cues.en: Then the chefs add in baskets of cauliflower and potatoes.

cues.zh: 把它们全部拌匀，让蔬菜均匀裹上香料
cues.en: They mix everything together to evenly coat the veggies

cues.zh: 并继续翻炒，直到炒熟为止。
cues.en: and continue stirring until they're finished cooking.

cues.zh: langar 菜单上日常必备的一道主食
cues.en: An everyday staple on the langar's menu

cues.zh: 是新鲜的 dal，也就是劈开的扁豆。
cues.en: is fresh dal, or split lentils.

cues.zh: 绿扁豆、黄扁豆和棕扁豆
cues.en: Green, yellow, and brown lentils
are all washed by hand daily

cues.zh: 然后放进装满水的锅里。
cues.en: and added into a pot full of water.
The lentils are then seasoned with salt,
chili powder,
and turmeric
and covered.
Narrator: Across the kitchen,
flatbreads are made using machines.
Narrator: While these machines

cues.zh: 制作了langar所需的大部分面包，
cues.en: make a majority of the bread the langar uses,

cues.zh: 但厨房里还有另一个区域，
cues.en: there is another area of the kitchen

cues.zh: 专门手工制作这些薄饼。
cues.en: dedicated to making these breads by hand.

cues.zh: 这样做是为了让人们践行seva，
cues.en: This is done so people can practice seva,

cues.zh: 即无私服务，这是锡克教的信条之一。
cues.en: or selfless service, a tenet of Sikhism.
Narrator: The langar officially opens its doors
at 5 a.m. to serve food.

cues.zh: 旁白：由于这家厨房太受欢迎，
cues.en: Narrator: Because of the kitchen's popularity,
it's not uncommon for people to wait

cues.zh: 两个半小时，只为吃一顿免费餐。
cues.en: 2 ½ hours outside to get a free meal.
Inside the dining hall, visitors take their seats

cues.zh: 沿着被称为 pangats 的长排并肩而坐。
cues.en: side by side in long rows known as pangats.
This style of seating is an important part
of the temple's philosophy

cues.zh: 旨在促进平等、消除歧视。
cues.en: of promoting equality and ending discrimination.
Narrator: Once everyone is seated,
volunteers known as sevadaars

cues.zh: 会带领大家进行宗教诵唱，以纪念宗师。
cues.en: lead a religious chant in honor of the guru.
Then the servers come around

cues.zh: 往金属盘里大勺大勺地盛食物。
cues.en: spooning large portions of food into metal plates.
And while the amount of food one can eat is unlimited,
there is a rule
that not a single bite of food can be wasted.

cues.zh: 所以吃完时盘子必须干干净净。
cues.en: So plates must be clean before finishing the meal.
Narrator: When a batch of guests has finished eating,

cues.zh: 工作人员会清扫并冲洗地面
cues.en: workers sweep and wash the floors
before another group is allowed to enter.
